nameEn: Building of ships and floating structures
description: This class includes the building of ships and floating structures for commercial and other uses.
includes: building of commercial vessels: cargo ships, tankers, bulk carriers, container ships, ferries, cruise ships
building of fishing vessels and factory ships
building of floating structures: floating docks, pontoons, coffer-dams, floating platforms, floating piers, floating landing stages, buoys, floating tanks
building of drillships and floating oil and gas platforms
manufacture of marine engines (outboard and inboard)
excludes: building of sports and recreational boats, see 3012
manufacture of ship or boat propellers, see 2599
construction of harbour and port facilities, see 4290
